decision.explanation: Q01 is broadly similar to C01 (excess_hall_adhesive). C01 is the only reference supported by the distance ranking: 3.150 dB is markedly smaller than the 7.617–10.596 dB distances to C02–C04 and smaller than C01's 5.943 dB separation from its nearest known condition. Figures and measurements support the match through the common 5.3 Hz component, identical 68.0 µs autocorrelation lag, periodic burst envelope, low-frequency comb, 4–8 kHz trough, and approximately 16 kHz feature. Q01 nevertheless has a new/shifted approximately 942 Hz cluster, greater 500–4000 Hz power, slightly higher envelope spacing, and lower FS RMS; these prevent an exact match but do not outweigh the overall gain-centered pattern. All reports use identical 10 s duration, 44.1 kHz sampling, 0.1 Hz FFT spacing, and 43.07 Hz Welch spacing, so axis, coverage, and resolution differences do not explain the ranking; absolute FS levels remain gain-dependent.
